## Pull request overview

Moves i18n HTTP route ownership out of the protocol-level `RestServer` and into the i18n service layer, while also adding dispatcher bridge routes so i18n endpoints continue working when only the kernel’s fallback i18n service is present.

**Changes:**
- Removed `enableI18n` from `RestApiConfigSchema` and deleted RestServer’s i18n endpoint registration.
- Added self-registering i18n routes to `I18nServicePlugin` (with `registerRoutes` + `basePath` options) and a new test suite.
- Added i18n bridge routes to `createDispatcherPlugin()` and updated RestServer tests + docs (ROADMAP/CHANGELOG).

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/api/rest-server.zod.ts | Removes `enableI18n` flag from REST API config schema. |
| packages/services/service-i18n/src/i18n-service-plugin.ts | Adds kernel:ready-based self-registration for i18n HTTP routes. |
| packages/services/service-i18n/src/i18n-service-plugin.test.ts | Adds tests for i18n route self-registration and handler behavior. |
| packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts | Adds i18n HTTP route bridges delegating to `HttpDispatcher.handleI18n()`. |
| packages/rest/src/rest.test.ts | Updates expectations: RestServer no longer registers i18n routes. |
| packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts | Removes i18n config and endpoint registration from RestServer. |
| ROADMAP.md | Notes i18n service now self-registers REST routes. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents architectural move + dispatcher bridge addition. |
</details>

I18nServicePlugin only registers `GET ${basePath}/labels/:object/:locale`, but HttpDispatcher.handleI18n (and ObjectStackClient.i18n.getFieldLabels) also supports/uses `GET /labels/:object?locale=...`. As-is, client requests will 404. Consider registering an additional `GET ${basePath}/labels/:object` route that reads `req.query.locale`, or otherwise support both route shapes.

The dispatcher i18n bridges only expose `/i18n/translations/:locale` and `/i18n/labels/:object/:locale`. HttpDispatcher.handleI18n explicitly supports (and the TS client uses) `/i18n/translations?locale=...` and `/i18n/labels/:object?locale=...`, so those client calls will still 404 even after this change. Add bridge routes for the query-param forms (and keep behavior consistent across both).

Test setup registers the HTTP server under the 'http-server' name, but production code commonly registers it as 'http.server' (with 'http-server' only as an alias in some server plugins). To catch real regressions, include 'http.server' in the mocked services (and update the plugin to prefer it).
```suggestion
    ctx = createMockPluginContext({ 'http-server': httpServer, 'http.server': httpServer });
```

These assertions lock in a non-standard response shape (`{ data: ... }`). The repo's JS client unwraps responses based on a `{ success, data }` envelope, so once the plugin is aligned with the standard envelope, these tests should assert the enveloped shape (and error shape) to prevent future incompatibilities.

These route handlers return `{ data: ... }` / `{ error: ... }`, which does not match the standard REST envelope used by ObjectStackClient.unwrapResponse (`{ success: boolean, data, meta? }` / `{ success:false, error:{message,code} }`). This will break client.i18n calls when served by I18nServicePlugin directly. Align the response shape with the standard envelope (and keep it consistent with HttpDispatcher.handleI18n / dispatcher-plugin).

I18nServicePlugin only registers `GET ${basePath}/translations/:locale`, but HttpDispatcher.handleI18n (and ObjectStackClient.i18n.getTranslations) also supports/uses the query form `GET /translations?locale=...`. With the current routing, client requests to `/translations?locale=...` will 404. Consider registering an additional `GET ${basePath}/translations` route (reading `req.query.locale`) or supporting both patterns.
